objective.name: sandbox.reflect.mixed.summary
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that composes one local read.meaning with one remote meaning.query.

#root.role: Read one local capacity meaning descriptor, rebuild and query one remote root meaning projection, then return one normalized synthesis spanning both reflective sources.

effects.local_reflexive_read: The wrapper performs one local detailed meaning read.
effects.remote_reflexive_query: The wrapper rebuilds and queries one remote root meaning projection.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper request becomes a mixed reflective synthesis after one local detailed meaning read and one remote projected meaning selection.
invariants: The wrapper always performs one local read.meaning plus one remote meaning.rebuild and one remote meaning.query.
summary is deterministically built as local_name:remote_name:remote_ctx.
The payload keeps local detailed meaning and remote projected meaning concerns separated.
success: On success, sandbox.reflect.mixed.summary returns local_name, local_role, remote_name, remote_row_count, remote_rebuild_status, remote_query_status, summary, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.
An empty remote selection remains a valid successful outcome and is reflected through remote_row_count and remote_name.
failure: The capability fails if any of the local or remote outbound reflective calls cannot complete.
Missing local_name or remote_name fall back to sandbox.echo instead of causing a contract failure.
notes: This capability is used to prove mixed local detailed meaning plus remote projected meaning composition.
The wrapper payload is intentionally summarized for DSL branching and assertion simplicity.
